# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before changing this repository, read and follow the root `AGENTS.md`. It is the canonical guide for project scope, evidence quality, image licensing, diagnostic safety, branch discipline, and required checks.

Do not describe the color-based screening workflow as a trained disease classifier. The French-grape Esca ONNX pilot is experimental, limited to two source classes, and not validated on Syrian coastal field images. Never translate its no-Esca class into a healthy-plant diagnosis or present its raw score as a calibrated probability.
